title: A rebuilt place to play
summary:
A rebuilt Hello site brings generation and interactive docs together, with smaller updates to community apps, news, and Enter.

The Hello site gained a responsive React rebuild with image and text generation, a vision-capable model selector, a community creations feed, and interactive API examples. Prompt-driven theme controls were added but are disabled in production.

Robatika joined the creative projects directory, while the Hacktoberfest chat app was updated to use the intended key type for browser requests.

The highlights file and README now recap December 7 video, model, web-search, and Flux updates. These are news updates, not new changes to those models or APIs.

highlights.text: The rebuilt Hello site's Play page brings image and text generation together with a vision-capable model selector and a feed of community creations.

highlights.title: Interactive API examples
highlights.text: The rebuilt Docs page adds interactive image and text API examples, plus model discovery and authentication guidance.
